Title: Aditya and the Family

Cast

1. Aditya - 9 years, son
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
2. Meenakshi - 39 years, mother
Look: green saree
3. Vikram - 43 years, father
Look: white kurta-pyjama
4. Zoya - 13 years, daughter
Look: green salwar-kurta, short hair
5. Siya - 10 years, friend
Look: yellow frock, two plaits

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The main road - a wide road, traffic lights

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Aditya stands in the courtyard. Meenakshi and Vikram stand near him.]

Aditya: "Let's do something fun today."

[Aditya walks across the courtyard.]

Aditya: "Careful!"

[Aditya jumps with joy.]

Aditya: "What happened?"

[Aditya tiptoes across the courtyard.]

Aditya: "Really?"

[Aditya hides behind the tree.]

Vikram: "Oh wow!"

[Aditya searches for his lost ball.]

Aditya: "One more time!"

[Aditya peeks out from behind the door.]

Vikram: "Careful!"

Scene 2: The main road - Day

[Aditya stands on the road. Meenakshi, Vikram and Zoya stand near him.]

Vikram: "What a nice place."

[Father drives the car; Mother sits beside him in the front and Aditya sits in the back seat.]

Zoya: "That's easy."

[Aditya sits in the front passenger seat while Mother drives.]

Vikram: "Let's see."

[The family gets into the car: Father at the wheel, Aditya in the back.]

Aditya (surprised): "That was such a fun day!"
